title: The worst day for US chip stocks since March 2020
text: Analysts blamed fears that Democrats will curb data center building, above all in Texas. A two-minute film on what is known.

title: The internet is about 600 cables on the sea floor
text: On Christmas Day 2024 a tanker dragged its anchor at least 90 km across the Gulf of Finland and five cables broke. A two-minute film on why they keep getting cut.

title: A Hormuz exemption list that nobody has published
text: A viral headline said Iran exempts India, China, Iraq and Qatar. It traces to one Iranian lawmaker, with no published list and no Reuters or AP report.

title: About 500 million Indians crossed the $4.20-a-day line
text: The World Bank says it took 12 years. India published no household survey for 11 of them, and the method changed.

title: The Buddha, before the statues
text: One line on a stone pillar at Lumbini names his birthplace. A film on what the oldest texts say about the man.

title: Nonprofit Money Map
text: Most New York nonprofits take little government money. About 1 in 7 runs mostly on it. Built from 20,244 Form 990 filers.

title: The machine loads faster on phones
text: Boot files now load in parallel. First content on a throttled 4G phone fell from 2,527 ms to 2,235 ms.

title: Resume added to the hall
text: A public PDF copy of my resume, linked from the home page.

title: Cyberpunk City
text: Walk into the live Corner Block diorama.

title: The universe home and seven interactive decks
text: The first version of this site: one machine to walk through, and seven decks, each its own small machine.
